responsibility: This header declares the `lockfile` RAII-style helper used to synchronize GCC processes via a dedicated filesystem lock file. It stores the filename and file descriptor, provides blocking write/read lock operations, a nonblocking write-lock attempt, unlock and lock-state queries, copy/move-style ownership transfer behavior, and a static capability query for lockfile support. It is the interface layer for GCC's simple advisory file-lock wrapper.
same_name_distinction: Declares the `lockfile` helper class, its API, stored state, and transfer/RAII-style interface. In this same-name pair, the .cc provides the actual `fcntl`-based locking, unlocking, and support-detection behavior.
